Hi Asha,

Thanks again for taking time today — appreciated the transparency on the use case and timing. Quick recap so we're aligned and can move toward a short pilot: 

- Primary use case: customer support triage + automated summary for tier-2 (avg ticket length ~450 words).
- Success metrics proposed: 30% reduction in average resolution time and 15% decrease in escalations over a 4-week pilot.
- Data constraints: all logs will be redacted; PII removed on your side; we discussed bringing a sanitized subset for the initial run.

What I can do next (proposal):
1) Share a short one-pager on the pilot scope + quick config (attached: Redwood-brief.pdf).
2) Draft a mutual action plan with milestones and owner names (I can push a template — attaching a starter MAP).
3) Provide a pricing snippet for a 4-week pilot and the expected infra footprint.

Are you still comfortable with the 6–8 week timeline you mentioned on the call? If yes, I can send over the MAP and a couple of available pilot kickoff slots next week.

If you want, I can loop in our Solutions Engineer (Marissa) — she’s CC’d and can run through the data/ingest notes.

Thanks,
